1.name: Pressurized Glands
1.desc: Increases the range of Symbiote's Spike Burst by 25% and decreases its cooldown by 1 second.

1.name: Envenomed Nest
1.desc: Toxic Nests deal 75% more damage over 3 seconds and reduce enemy Hero Armor by 15 for 4 seconds.

1.name: Reinforced Carapace
1.desc: Increases the Shield amount of Symbiote's Carapace by 40%.

1.name: Locust Brood
1.desc: Activate to spawn 3 Locusts at target location.

4.name: Adrenal Overload
4.desc: Symbiote host gains 25% increased Attack Speed.

4.name: Needlespine
4.desc: Increases the damage and range of Symbiote's Stab by 20%.

4.name: Prolific Dispersal
4.desc: Increases Toxic Nest duration by 45 seconds, reduces cooldown by 2 seconds, and adds 2 additional charges.

4.name: Slapathur
4.desc: Abathur's Basic Attacks deal 350% additional damage and Stun non-Elite enemies and disable Structures for 1.5 seconds (6s cooldown per target).

7.name: Vile Nest
7.desc: Toxic Nests Slow enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

7.name: Networked Carapace
7.desc: Using Symbiote's Carapace also applies an untalented Shield to all nearby allied Heroes, Minions, and Mercenaries.

7.name: Calldown: MULE
7.desc: Activate to call down a Mule that repairs target Structure for 40 seconds, healing for 90 Health per second.

10.name: Ultimate Evolution
10.desc: Clone target allied Hero for 20 seconds. Grants 20% Spell Power, 20% Attack Damage, and 10% Movement Speed.

10.name: Evolve Monstrosity
10.desc: Turn an allied Minion or Locust into a Monstrosity that gains Health and Attack Damage when nearby enemy Minions die.

13.name: Spatial Efficiency
13.desc: Symbiote's Stab gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds.

13.name: Soma Transference
13.desc: Symbiote's Spike Burst heals the host per enemy Hero hit.

13.name: Bombard Strain
13.desc: Locust Basic Attacks become long-range siege attacks that deal bonus damage to Structures.

16.name: Envenomed Spikes
16.desc: Symbiote's Spike Burst Slows enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2 seconds.

16.name: Adrenaline Boost
16.desc: Symbiote's Carapace increases the Movement Speed of the target by 40% for 3.5 seconds.

16.name: Volatile Mutation
16.desc: Ultimate Evolution clones and Monstrosities pulse damage to nearby enemies every 3 seconds and upon death.

16.name: Survival Instincts
16.desc: Increases Locust Health by 50% and duration by 50%.

20.name: Evolutionary Link
20.desc: While Ultimate Evolution clone is active, the original target gains a Shield equal to 35% of max Health.

20.name: Evolution Complete
20.desc: Monstrosity gains the ability to Deep Tunnel to any visible location on a 30 second cooldown.

20.name: Hivemind
20.desc: Symbiote automatically targets a second nearby allied Hero.

20.name: Locust Nest
20.desc: Activate to spawn a nest that periodically spawns Locusts.
